attr.title: Streets of Rage 4
attr.desc: Streets of Rage 4 Android v1.4.5 through a native AArch64 .NET 9/MonoGame GLES host. Automatic 1GB, 2GB and High profiles provide native ASTC where supported, ETC2/ETC1 fallbacks, bounded on-demand texture streaming and transactional resumable setup. BYO-data; game files are not included.
attr.inst: Copy one legal Android v1.4.5 source into sor4/gamedata: a complete merged ARM64 APK, every APK split from the same complete installation, or one complete .apks/.apkm/.xapk bundle. Launch once to validate and install; the original source is preserved.
